title: Mission control split between NASA and the Air Force

tellings.quote: at the consoles. And you look to the left, it's exactly the same, but it's all Air Force people.

plain: Mission control at Cape Canaveral, the Florida launch site, is split in two, according to a man named Chris Bledsoe who says he attracts UFOs and was shown around: NASA staff sit at the consoles on one side, and on the other side "it's exactly the same, but it's all Air Force people." Bledsoe, who says he saw it himself, mentions a man named Timothy Taylor as part of the visit. He tells it to Michels as a sign that the military quietly sits alongside the space agency.
